Repositories — directory listings

Live listings of every module in the SuperUnicode project.

SuperUnicode (Base SUCS) module

Base SuperUnicode: core, framing, Public/ tree (SUCD, sudat, names, collation, charts, mappings, partitions).

SuperUnicode Extended (ExtSUCS) module

Extended SuperUnicode: extSUTF, plugin subsystem, SDK, and the Extended Public/ tree (registry, plugins, transport).

SUTF module

SUCS UTF-8 / UTF-16 / UTF-32 transformation formats and tests.

extSUTF module

Extended transformation: vsutf encoder over sucs_ex_char_t (64-bit).

SUST module

Serialization transports: SUST-16/32/64/128/256/512/N fixed-width and e-SUST page-mapped IPC, over sucs_ex_char_t (64-bit).

Unified module

The one translation unit that compiles every public header of every module, plus its build wiring.
